context_requirements: Functional cysteinyl-leukotriene or LTB4 receptor signaling, which is largely restricted to leukocytes, mast cells, and airway structural cells
An inflammatory or leukotriene-driven activation state; unstimulated transformed lines lack this
Presence of the relevant receptor (CYSLTR1/CYSLTR2/LTB4R/LTB4R2) at meaningful levels
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Induction of a coherent inflammatory or leukotriene-pathway transcriptional signature
Shared transcriptional response across multiple lines that tracks with receptor expression

evidence.supports: Montelukast modulates microglial and neuroinflammatory gene expression in a disease model, indicating the target is relevant mainly in inflammatory contexts
Cys-LTR antagonist affects T lymphocyte proliferation and apoptosis in vitro, showing activity is confined to leukocyte populations
Pranlukast attenuates airway remodeling via TGF-beta signaling in allergic inflammation models
Leukotriene receptor antagonist blocks LTD4-induced MUC2/5AC expression in airway epithelial cells
Cysteinyl-LT receptor antagonist reduces inflammation and bone loss in experimental periodontitis
